title: Boosting System-on-Chip Performance Through AI-Assisted Optimization Using Compositional Neural Networks
problem: SOC performance verification and pre-silicon optimization involves tuning many parameters (frequency, voltage, routing) to meet targets; manual optimization is time-consuming and error-prone.
motivation: Complex parameter interdependencies make manual SOC optimization impractical; need for automated, efficient optimization framework leveraging AI.
method: Three-stage framework: (1) Train neural models at component/cluster interfaces on SOC dataset to predict performance from design parameters, (2) Neural networks guide search algorithm to find optimal configurations, (3) Compositional neural network at SOC level using interface-level parameters.
key_novelty: Application of compositional neural networks to SOC optimization; leverages interface-level models to build system-level predictor without expensive full SOC modeling.
contributions: Compositional neural network framework for SOC optimization
Interface-level neural models for component performance prediction
Reduced training time vs full SOC models
limitations: Abstract only; no experimental results provided; no benchmark datasets mentioned; no comparison with existing SOC optimization tools; scalability to real industrial SOCs not demonstrated.
primary_theme: AI-assisted design automation for SOC optimization
